title: Mystic Crystal Ball Vision
description: A glowing purple crystal ball with a golden ornate base rests on a stone surface scattered with purple crystals. Inside the orb is a surreal female face with three eyes, a curly mustache, and large rabbit ears, set against a black and white geometric landscape with lavender flowers.
prompt: A glowing purple crystal ball with an ornate golden base sits on a stone floor with scattered crystals. Inside the orb appears a surreal woman's face with three eyes, a curly black mustache, and large white rabbit ears with triangle patterns. Her hair is purple and the background inside the ball is a black and white geometric landscape with lavender flowers and abstract shapes. Outside the ball is a vibrant psychedelic desert scene with red mountains, a purple starry sky, a ringed planet, and a small explorer figure with a backpack walking towards the orb.
